title: Implementing Sustainable Type 2 Diabetes Care Through a Community Health Worker-Led Intervention
official: Implementing Sustainable Type 2 Diabetes Care: A Hybrid Type 1 RCT to Test a Community Health Worker-Led Evidence-Based Intervention
summary: This Hybrid Type 1 randomized controlled trial will test a Community Health Worker-led, evidence-based intervention designed to improve type 2 diabetes management in community health center settings. The study will evaluate both patient-level outcomes, including glycemic control and diabetes self-management, and implementation outcomes to inform the sustainable integration of the intervention into routine clinical practice.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults (\>/=18 years)
* Low-income status (e.g., earning \<150% of the U.S. federal poverty level)
* Uncontrolled type 2 diabetes (e.g., baseline HbA1c \>7.0%)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Type 1 diabetes
* Factors affecting HbA1c (e.g., variable corticosteroid use), and conditions limiting participation suitability (e.g., severe cognitive impairment).
